name: AccelDiff AdaptiveDiff step skipping
plain: Forks core solvers and tracks mean absolute change of the latent per step. When the second difference of that change is small relative to the last change, it reuses the previous x0 prediction with no model call. A guard forces a real call after max_skip_steps skips.
math: Δ_k = mean|x_k − x_{k−1}|. Skip next if |(Δ_k + Δ_{k−2})/2 − Δ_{k−1}| ≤ threshold·Δ_{k−1}. Force a call if len(mask)>4 and none of the last max_skip_steps masks are true. On skip denoised = last real denoised (stale x0, not extrapolated). First 4 steps always call. Defaults max_skip_steps=3, threshold=0.01.

props.stages: 0 on skipped steps for single-eval solvers
